user.title: Connect to PowerPanel Cloud
user.description: Choose how to authenticate. The API key method uses CyberPower's official API and is recommended. Generate a key in the PowerPanel Cloud web portal under Management → API.

api_key.title: Official API key
api_key.description: Enter the API key generated in the PowerPanel Cloud web portal (Management → API). PRO accounts and regions are detected automatically.

legacy.title: Legacy login
legacy.description: Enter your PowerPanel Cloud account credentials. Note: accounts with two-factor authentication are not supported by the legacy method — use an API key instead.

error.invalid_api_key: Invalid API key. Check the key in the PowerPanel Cloud portal under Management → API.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to PowerPanel Cloud. Check your network.
error.two_factor_unsupported: This account has two-factor authentication enabled, which the legacy method does not support. Use the API key method instead.

abort.already_configured: This PowerPanel Cloud account is already configured.
